title: lupinus microcarpus var. recurvatus
intro: Lupinus microcarpus var. recurvatus, commonly known as the Purple Spurred Lupine, is a variety of the Lupinus microcarpus plant, which is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, such as digestive problems, respiratory issues, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus microcarpus var. recurvatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating these conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
